<div class="wc-intro">
<p>This page lists the changes to the guide to assembling a dataset of New York City Council discretionary funding that a reader would notice: new sections, new data, data fixes, and corrections when we published something wrong. Newest first.</p>
<ul><li><strong>History begins:</strong> 2026-10-08. The guide was first published on this date. Corrections made before it may be missing.</li><li><strong>Data refresh:</strong> Not on a schedule. The guide reads files saved in this repository, and its downloads run only when someone turns them on by hand.</li></ul>
<p>To report a bug in this guide, or to ask for a new feature, <a href="https://github.com/BetaNYC/schedule-c-assembly-guide/issues">open an issue on GitHub</a>.</p>
</div>

<p class="wc-meta"><time datetime="2026-11-12">November 12, 2026</time></p>

<article class="wc-entry" id="2026-10-08-the-guide-is-published" data-tags="Site Data" aria-labelledby="2026-10-08-the-guide-is-published-title">
<h2 id="2026-10-08-the-guide-is-published-title">The guide is published</h2>
<p class="wc-meta"><time datetime="2026-10-08">October 8, 2026</time></p>
<p class="wc-tags"><span class="wc-visually-hidden">Tags: </span><span class="wc-tag">Site</span><span class="wc-visually-hidden">, </span><span class="wc-tag">Data</span></p>
<p>The first version of the guide went online. It reads the Council&#x27;s yearly Excel files of discretionary awards for fiscal years 2009 to 2026 into one table, renames their columns to match NYC Open Data, and compares them with the City Council Discretionary Funding dataset on NYC Open Data for the years both cover.</p>
<p><strong>More detail:</strong> <a href="https://betanyc.github.io/schedule-c-assembly-guide/">The guide</a> · <a href="https://github.com/BetaNYC/schedule-c-assembly-guide/commit/bfc9a71949f21c5f677b7a88a35a96ac1421405f">The change</a></p>
<p class="wc-permalink"><a href="#2026-10-08-the-guide-is-published">Link to this change<span class="wc-visually-hidden">: The guide is published</span></a></p>
</article>
<script>
(function () {
  var roots = document.querySelectorAll("[data-whats-changed]");
  Array.prototype.forEach.call(roots, function (root) {
    var box = root.querySelector(".wc-filters");
    var status = root.querySelector(".wc-status");
    var entries = root.querySelectorAll(".wc-entry");
    if (!box || !status || !entries.length) return;
    var tagBoxes = box.querySelectorAll("input[name='wc-tag']");
    var corrBox = box.querySelector("input[name='wc-corrections']");
    var total = entries.length;
    var noun = total === 1 ? "change" : "changes";
    function apply() {
      var on = {};
      Array.prototype.forEach.call(tagBoxes, function (b) { on[b.value] = b.checked; });
      var shown = 0;
      Array.prototype.forEach.call(entries, function (el) {
        var tags = (el.getAttribute("data-tags") || "").split(" ");
        var ok = tags.some(function (t) { return on[t]; });
        if (corrBox && corrBox.checked && tags.indexOf("Correction") < 0) ok = false;
        el.hidden = !ok;
        if (ok) shown++;
      });
      status.textContent = shown === total
        ? "Showing all " + total + " " + noun + "."
        : "Showing " + shown + " of " + total + " " + noun + ".";
    }
    function reveal() {
      var id = decodeURIComponent(location.hash.slice(1));
      var el = id && document.getElementById(id);
      if (el && root.contains(el) && el.closest(".wc-entry[hidden]")) {
        Array.prototype.forEach.call(tagBoxes, function (b) { b.checked = true; });
        if (corrBox) corrBox.checked = false;
        apply();
        el.scrollIntoView();
      }
    }
    box.addEventListener("change", apply);
    window.addEventListener("hashchange", reveal);
    box.hidden = false;
  });
})();
</script>
</div>
